title.en: Before the numbers reach the model

premise.zh: Daloopa 把公司财报里的明细数据结构化，供金融分析师直接接入模型，减少手工抄录。
premise.en: Daloopa turns filing-level financial detail into structured data an analyst can pull straight into a model, instead of re-keying it.

narration.zh: 同一份数据，不同岗位关心的部分完全不同。选一个看看。
narration.en: The same dataset matters differently depending on the desk. Pick one.

situation.zh: 要在财报发布当天更新模型里的分部数据。
situation.en: Needs segment-level detail updated in a model the day earnings drop.

outcome.zh: 拿到已结构化的历史序列，把时间花在判断上，而不是抄数字。
outcome.en: Gets an already-structured history and spends the time on judgment rather than transcription.

situation.zh: 想知道一家公司某项指标的口径是否中途变过。
situation.en: Wants to know whether a company quietly changed how it defines a metric.

outcome.zh: 对齐后的历史序列会暴露口径变化，这类问题在 PDF 里很难发现。
outcome.en: An aligned history exposes definition changes that are hard to spot reading PDFs.

situation.zh: 要把财报数据接入内部系统，但不想维护解析器。
situation.en: Needs filing data in internal systems without maintaining parsers.

outcome.zh: 以数据源的形式接入，解析和口径对齐由上游负责。
outcome.en: Consumes it as a feed; parsing and alignment stay upstream.

narration.zh: 要点在最后一步：数字能追回它在原始文件里的位置。
narration.en: The point is the last stage: a number can be traced back to where it appeared in the filing.

output.zh: 上千个科目行，为人阅读排版，不是为机器
output.en: thousands of line items, formatted for humans not machines

output.zh: 带类型的字段，跨期使用一致的标签
output.en: line items as typed fields with consistent labels across periods

input.zh: 同一家公司的多个报告期
input.en: many periods of the same company

output.zh: 即使公司自己改过列报方式，也能得到可比序列
output.en: a comparable series even where the company changed its own presentation

output.zh: 它来自哪份文件的哪个位置——这一步才让数据可审计
output.en: the document and position it came from — the part that makes it auditable

narration.zh: 下面是示意对话，用来说明这个产品替代掉的是哪一段工作，不代表真实界面。
narration.en: An illustrative exchange showing which piece of work this replaces. Not a real interface.

text.zh: 我要这家公司过去五年的分部收入，按季度。
text.en: I need five years of segment revenue for this company, quarterly.

text.zh: 已返回结构化序列，每个季度都关联到它来自的那份披露文件。
text.en: Structured series returned, with each quarter linked to the filing it came from.

text.zh: 这段时间中间他们改过分部的名字。
text.en: The segment names changed in the middle of that period.

text.zh: 序列已跨越这次变更对齐，口径发生变化的报告期会被标出来，而不是悄悄合并。
text.en: The series is aligned across the change, and the periods where the definition moved are marked rather than silently merged.

text.zh: FY23 Q2 这个数字是哪来的？
text.en: Where did the FY23 Q2 figure come from?

text.zh: 它对应到那个季度披露文件里的具体一行——这正是让数字可核对而不是只能选择相信的原因。
text.en: It resolves to the specific line in that quarter's filing — which is what makes the number checkable rather than trusted.

evidence.claim: Daloopa announced a $47M Series C for AI data infrastructure in finance.
